about.description:
APC3M is the 3 month USDC vault share token issued through R25 Protocol
  on Pharos Mainnet and curated by Axil as risk manager. The vault targets
  approximately 14.3 percent gross annualized yield (approximately 11.3 percent
  credit return plus 3 percent PROS ecosystem incentives) and is capped at
  approximately 100 million dollars. Underlying exposure is a diversified pool
  of short duration emerging market consumer loans across Mexico, Thailand,
  Philippines, Indonesia, and Pakistan sourced through a regulated private
  credit fund. Multi-layer protection is described as overcollateralization,
  pledged bank accounts, and junior capital buffers. Pricing is derived from
  the internal CoreVault Accountant pricePerShare, and reserves are attested by
  APEX with smart contract audits by SlowMist.
